speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyloric Stenosis. The combination of bilious vomiting (implied by bile in history), visible olive-shaped mass, and ultrasound confirmation of a distal obstruction is classic for this condition. Please arrange for an ultrasound to confirm the thickened pylorus immediately.
